scope: Mod compatibility and genuine OS API boundaries; no engine import

classes.A: Actual OS/API behavior; platform/platform_io.h isolates Windows/POSIX bounded native directory enumeration and native-only path separation. Engine filesystem/time/render services remain traps.
classes.B: Original numerical, floating-point and ABI compatibility; compat/legacy holds unchanged implementations.
classes.C: Compiler, architecture and engine ABI capability guards; existing predicates are retained until separately validated.
classes.D: Optional developer, authoring and editor capabilities; never enabled by compatibility headers.

facades.compat/compat_float.h: Float classification and original conversion profiles
facades.platform/platform_io.h: Native directory enumeration callback and path separator, distinct from engine VFS
facades.compat/compat_vector.h: Class C: targets without the existing Windows/Linux wide-return provider use unchanged SDK Float normalization and widen the result; no new x87 parity claim

preservation: 43 custom helper bodies relocated byte-for-byte from src/game and src/cgame
Original include paths remain as thin relative forwarding headers
Original guard predicates, arithmetic order, fallback paths and function signatures preserved
SDK public headers and SDK-identical implementations not edited
No new assembly, FPU flags, traps, compiler switches or profile selection
limitations: Existing Linux guards do not prove ARM or non-x87 numeric parity
MSVC long double remains binary64; existing x86 fixed-grid support is not automatically enabled elsewhere
Finite helper numerical results do not reproduce floating exception flags or unmasked traps
Private long-double helpers and existing platform-specific AngleDifference declarations require further ABI review
WASM ABI1 requires a matching engine host; compiling the module does not provide that host
Gameplay call-site precision branches remain classified migration work; this relocation does not claim complete elimination
